title: comfort-db: A Python toolkit to access, preprocess and explore the oceanographic COMFORT dataset
abstract: arXiv:2611.09353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: comfort-db is a Python library that facilitates working with the COMFORT SQLite dataset, version 2. The dataset assembles global oceanographic measurements from ten datasets and contains a total of 458,724,734 in situ measurements from the years 1772 to 2020. comfort-db enables easy access to the database and provides preprocessing and exploratory analysis utilities. Preprocessing supports variable scaling and filtering by space, time and quality. Unit conversions can be applied during data loading or separately via a converter object. Gridding is supported and optionally works with bathymetry data to exclude grid cells on land. Moreover, the library supports general and field-specific exploratory data analysis through plotting functions, an interactive Dash app and functions to compute oceanographic profile and water mass statistics. comfort-db is open source (MIT license) and available from PyPI and GitHub.

translated_title: comfort-db：一个用于访问、预处理和探索海洋学COMFORT数据集的Python工具包
translated_abstract: comfort-db是一个Python库，便于使用COMFORT SQLite数据集（版本2）。该数据集汇集了来自十个数据集的全球海洋学测量数据，包含1772年至2020年间总共458,724,734个现场测量值。comfort-db能够轻松访问数据库，并提供预处理和探索性分析工具。预处理支持变量缩放以及按空间、时间和质量进行过滤。单位转换可以在数据加载时应用，也可以通过转换器对象单独进行。该库支持网格化，并可选择结合测深数据来排除陆地上的网格单元。此外，该库通过绘图函数、交互式Dash应用程序以及计算海洋学剖面和水团统计信息的函数，支持通用和领域特定的探索性数据分析。comfort-db是开源的（MIT许可证），可从PyPI和GitHub获取。
tldr: comfort-db是一个开源Python工具包，简化了对包含1772-2020年间全球海洋现场测量数据的COMFORT数据集的访问、预处理（变量缩放、时空质量过滤、单位转换、结合测深数据的网格化）和探索性分析（绘图、交互式Dash应用、海洋学剖面与水团统计）。
en_tdlr: comfort-db is an open-source Python toolkit that simplifies access, preprocessing (scaling, spatiotemporal/quality filtering, unit conversion, bathymetry-aware gridding), and exploratory analysis (plotting, interactive Dash app, oceanographic profile and water mass statistics) of the COMFORT dataset containing global in situ oceanographic measurements from 1772 to 2020.
